name: Public Unity evidence baseline v1

label_review.rationale: Source-inspected at the pinned revision before retrieval evaluation. Exact physical ranges and unique literal passages checked against file hashes. Convenience sample; not independent human approval.

limits: Bindings are relative to supplied defines, per-assembly source and host .NET references; Unity compilation is not reproduced. Source assemblies are analyzed separately. Cross-assembly bindings require explicit DLL references.

Static serialized evidence only. Scalar values remain strings. Filename-to-class links are inferred. Only direct and unambiguous nested-mapping scalar overrides on plain source prefabs are resolved; nested/variant chains and structural overrides remain explicit records.
